items.title: Anime Lucky Blocks
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Anime Lucky Blocks is great for anyone who loves anime and lucky blocks. Break one block at a time because you will never know the outcome! These red blocks might have something good or bad inside of them!

- Anime themed world
- Lucky blocks experience

items.title: Vikings
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready to roleplay as a Viking! Conquer your next Minecraft world in style with Viking attire! 

+ 10 Viking skins
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: My Life in Sakura Shores
items.creator: Imagiverse
items.description:
Start your new life in the peaceful city of Sakura Shores! Earn houses, furniture, pets, and vehicles by playing exciting festival minigames and jobs. Explore a detailed, anime-inspired world filled with cute characters, shops, and surprises!

*Decorate 10 homes from beach cottage to zen mansion
*1000+ furniture choices, including modern and kawaii styles
*Custom music
items.changelog:
Pet Update!
* Cute playful pets come to Sakura Shores!
* Adopt multiple types of pets, each with different looks.
* Take care of them by brushing, feeding and playing ball with them!
* Explore the town with your pet to dig up rewards!
* Decorate your house with furniture for your pet!

items.title: Neon Pirates
items.creator: The Rage Craft Room
items.description:
Jolly Roger is glowing bright! No ship now shall get lost at night. 
Anchors aweigh, this neon crew, with a chest of gold on an ocean blue. 
15 pirate mateys fit to explore. This skin pack is a treasure. Don't let it wash to shore.

items.title: Among Techno Space
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Colorful techno suits up in space? Sign me up! These astronaut skins look super cool. Which suit color will you choose?

- 15 skins

items.title: Demon Castle
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Beware of the shadows hiding in the dark, this is not a dream, this is your worst nightmare. Uncover the secrets hidden in the depths of the demon's lair. Only your soul can survive this darkness.

- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Think Pink
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Pretty in pink is an understatement! You'll look completely adorable in your new pink wardrobe. Put on a cute outfit and hang out with some friends.

- 11 skins

items.title: Blazin Billionaires
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These mobs are on fire!

items.title: Bots
items.creator: House of How
items.description: A family of beat boxin bots. They are always the life of the party. 6 colorful robot skins who love to match and take life to the extremes.

items.title: SCP Mobs Class D
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
New recruits incoming. 13 SCP-themed Class D Mobs and personnel specifically chosen for the most dangerous of test subjects. How long will they last? Will they escape their imprisonment and rebel? Keep these skins contained. They can be just as lethal as our experiments.

CC-BY-SA

items.title: Mob Ghosts!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Mob Ghosts have been sighted haunting the world of Minecraft!
Become a scary specter and spook your friends and enemies!

+ 10 Mob Ghost skins!
+ 2 free skins!
+ Includes ghost creeper, skeleton, and witch skins!

items.title: MEGA Village
items.creator: Jigarbov Productions
items.description:
Tired of regular-sized villages? How about a MEGA Village! This is a meticulously crafted village made MEGA with mega blocks. Each mega block is made up of smaller blocks, you'll be playing survival in a whole new way. Complete the plaque monument!

+ Village made of MEGA blocks.
+ Lots of challenges to complete!
By Jigarbov Productions

items.title: Crypto Cops
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
You’re on the covert cipher case in Crypto Cops skins. Gear up in unique uniforms with high-tech colorful graphics, badge, and cap to catch the criminals. Role-play with friends using all your encryption and decryption skills and techno tools. Break the secret code, bring in the suspects, and save the day!

+ 8 digital deciphering HD skins

items.title: Cliff Goats
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Romp around the city and then climb up the Minecraft hills in authentic Goats skins. Spotted or shaggy, have a really good time grazing or head-butting when you role-play with friends as does, billies, or kids. Lower your horns and charge ahead if you want to fight or defend your herd. Don’t let anyone get your goat!

+ 8 bleating bearded HD skins

items.title: Cows vs Chickens
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Which will come first, the chicken or the cow? Find out when you fight it out in Cows vs Chickens skins. Challenge fowl enemies when you role-play with friends as battling bovine forces, moooving from the barn to the pasture. Break out of the coop to peck and squawk and strut your stuff. Who will win this clash, the herd or the flock?

+ 8 Holsteins vs. Leghorns HD skins

items.title: Teen Trillionaires
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
It's time to celebrate the weekend by sporting the latest and most expensive fashion trends around town. With each piece of clothing looking like a million bucks, this skin pack of designer-style teen clothing will turn a lot of heads!

- Includes 8 colorful fashion choices
- Each outfit is curated for any occasion
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Lucky Spring
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Say goodbye to the cold and hello to warmer weather and blooming flowers in style with this skin pack of fashionable, yet breathable Spring outfits. With tank tops, shorts, vests, and sandals, there's plenty of options for everyone.

- Includes 8 unique outfits
- Choose between human and animal options
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Lucky Zodiac Teens
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Are you a diehard fan of zodiac signs and readings? The time to represent yours while walking down the street has come with this zodiac-themed skin pack! Each character showcases a unique outfit with an appropriate zodiac symbol to match.

- Includes a whopping 12 flashy and unique skins!
- Male and female options for all players
- By SmartPixel & Pathway Studios

items.title: Cursed Castle
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
A dreadful castle lay hidden deep inside the tall mountains. Some say it's protected by horrifying monsters. Would you dare explore the castle's secrets? The choice is yours!

Search the castle haunted hallways and free it from the curse. Rebuild it, decorate it and make it to be your home.

- Survival spawn adventure
- Play alone or with friends
- 4 medieval skins, 1 free

items.title: The Pond
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Come down to the pond and meet all of these adorable animals! There's a duck and frog! Or maybe you could become a toad today?

- 8 animals

items.title: Anime Sports
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
These fancy sports stars are at the top of their league! Are you ready to win even more competitions? Choose your favorite athlete and start playing!

- 12 anime skins
- 2 free skins
- Athletes bundle
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from LeadPro.

items.title: Pirate Adventures
items.creator: Norvale
items.description:
Ahoy! Set sail and head off on an epic pirate adventure! Explore mystic islands, fight evil creatures, and gather treasures!
You can enjoy the adventure by yourself, but it's even more fun accompanied by fellow pirate-friends! 

+ Working ships and rafts
+ Multiple custom bosses
+ Custom creatures
+ Hidden treasures
+ Lots of dungeons
+ 10 skins included

By Timolia

items.title: Dogcraft Skin Pack
items.creator: StacyPlays
items.description:
Blend into the world of DOGCRAFT! In this pack based on the YouTube series, Stacy's classic skin is joined by the Minecraft versions of her real-life pets: Page, Molly, Polly, Milquetoast & Pipsqueak (plus her whole wolf pack).

+ 12 StacyPlays variants
+ 3 dogs: Page, Molly & Polly
+ 2 cats: Milquetoast & Pipsqueak
+ 6 wolves: Addison, Basil, Everest, Noah, Tucker & Wink

items.title: Logdotzip Jobs
items.creator: Logdotzip
items.description:
From Advanced Army Camo, to Fancy Space Suits, choose from some of the coolest jobs / careers, and roleplay them as Logdotzip! Survive in Minecraft, build a modern city, save millionaire mansions from firestorms, make new secret bases, teach in school, and more, all with these new skins!

* 12 awesome CUSTOM skins to choose from
